title: Key
content:
Type: KEYM
Papyrus: Key Script, ObjectReference Script A key is used to unlock a Door. If the matching key for a locked door is found in the Actors inventory, they may automatically unlock the door and enter. The Key object is found within the Object Window under the Items Category. Editor Dialog: File:Key Object.png - - - - * - - - - - - - - - - - See Also: - MiscItem - Keyword - Items Category
